The '''Öetrago system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Öetrago/Legends|Öetrago]].
